entries.0db4f229ec4ef61b: Elitz Co., Ltd., which provides rental brokerage for rental condominiums and apartments, operates 68 stores in the Kinki region, centered on Kyoto and Shiga. In addition to the group's managed properties, it also brokers properties managed by other companies and by owners who manage their own properties, and it also handles fire insurance referrals and brokerage-related services such as indoor disinfection and moving. Elitz Real Estate Sales Co., Ltd. handles brokerage for sales of general homes and investment condominiums, while the company earns rental income from rental condominiums and commercial buildings it owns in Kyoto City, and also carries out the real estate rental business, the real estate development business that plans investment condominiums, and the specified joint real estate business. In Malaysia, a local subsidiary provides rental and sales brokerage and operates and manages monthly and weekly apartments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,311 million, the largest of the three businesses.

entries.c8d74a95dd5beb36: This business provides services that help residents live with peace of mind, using resident information accumulated through the real estate brokerage and real estate management businesses. It conducts insurance agency business such as fire insurance, rent guarantee business for unpaid rent and other payments, and post-move-in services such as 24-hour, 365-day emergency assistance. VAST Co., Ltd. handles the call center business, providing referrals for internet connections, electricity and gas from new power suppliers, and NHK subscriptions, and also develops and sells the customer management system "Basstorage" for real estate agencies. Elitz Co., Ltd. also carries out the moving business under the "Benkei Moving Service" brand, as well as the used goods and estate clearance business and the shared cycle business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥767 million.
entries.d1560fecc4196be3: Elitz Building Management Co., Ltd. manages rental condominiums, apartments and other rental properties. It performs maintenance and management of buildings and tenant management, and also acts as the prime contractor for renovation work when tenants move out. The number of units under management was 28,685 in the fiscal year ended September 2025. ARC Building Management Co., Ltd. provides maintenance and management of condominiums for sale and supports the operation of condominium management associations, and also handles cleaning services for managed properties. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,307 million.
